hook.name: RookHook
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook for tokenized US equities that sets LP fees based on the US equity market session derived from block.timestamp — 30 bps during regular hours, 60 bps pre/post-market, 100 bps when closed, with a 300 bps decaying surcharge at market open and a 2500 bps genesis decay on first liquidity add. All fees accrue to LPs.
